roadmap.title: Base game: progression and collecting
roadmap.description: Level up, craft, restore Devotion shrines, earn faction reputation, open chests and gather lore notes in the main campaign.

roadmap.title: Base game: bosses and challenges
roadmap.description: Defeat the campaign bosses and optional challenge targets on Normal, Ultimate and Hardcore.

roadmap.title: The Crucible
roadmap.description: Survive the Crucible arena waves, score points, build defenses and use Celestial Blessings.

roadmap.title: Ashes of Malmouth
roadmap.description: Clear the Ashes of Malmouth campaign, its factions, bosses and secrets.

roadmap.title: Forgotten Gods
roadmap.description: Clear the Forgotten Gods campaign, the Shattered Realm, cults and the Tomb of the Heretic.

roadmap.title: Fangs of Asterkarn
roadmap.description: Clear the Fangs of Asterkarn campaign, its factions, bosses, Ascension altar and Ascendant Mode.

achievements.description: Eradicate 25 Heroic Monsters (marked by a Star).
achievements.summary: Kill 25 Heroic monsters, which are marked with a star.

steps.text: Kill monsters that have an orange name and a star above them until you have killed 25.

achievements.description: Eradicate 100 Heroic Monsters (marked by a Star).
achievements.summary: Kill 100 Heroic monsters, which are marked with a star.

steps.text: Keep killing star-marked monsters until you have killed 100.

achievements.description: Eradicate 1000 Heroic Monsters (marked by a Star).
achievements.summary: Kill 1000 Heroic monsters, which are marked with a star.

steps.text: Keep killing star-marked monsters until you have killed 1000.

achievements.description: Slay a Nemesis monster on Elite or Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Kill a single Nemesis monster while playing Elite or Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Fight one type of monster until your standing with that group reaches Nemesis in the Faction menu.
On Elite or Ultimate difficulty, kill the Nemesis monster that appears. Its name is red. Elite needs the game finished on Normal and Veteran first; Ultimate needs Elite finished too.

achievements.description: Slay Six Nemesis monsters on Elite or Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of six Nemesis monsters while playing Elite or Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Keep raising hostility with monster groups until their Nemesis monsters appear.
Kill a total of six Nemesis monsters while playing Elite or Ultimate difficulty. Elite needs the game finished on Normal and Veteran first; Ultimate needs Elite finished too.

achievements.description: Rid Cairn of 25,000 Monsters.
achievements.summary: Kill 25,000 monsters with one character.

steps.text: Kill monsters until the kill counter reaches 25,000 on one character.

achievements.description: Rid Cairn of 50,000 Monsters.
achievements.summary: Kill 50,000 monsters with one character.

steps.text: Kill monsters until the kill counter reaches 50,000 on one character.

achievements.description: Rid Cairn of 100,000 Monsters.
achievements.summary: Kill 100,000 monsters with one character.

steps.text: Kill monsters until the kill counter reaches 100,000 on one character.

achievements.description: Reach Revered reputation with any Faction.
achievements.summary: Reach Revered reputation with any one faction.

steps.text: Do quests and bounties for one friendly faction until the Faction menu shows Revered.

achievements.description: Reach Revered reputation with 6 Factions.
achievements.summary: Reach Revered reputation with six factions.

guide.context: You must pick Kymon's Chosen or the Order of Death's Vigil in the quest @loc{Allies Among the Ashes}, so only one of them can count.

steps.text: Reach Revered with the Black Legion, then Devil's Crossing, Homestead, Rovers and The Outcast, plus one of Kymon's Chosen or the Order of Death's Vigil.

achievements.description: Reach Revered reputation with Kymon's Chosen.
achievements.summary: Reach Revered reputation with Kymon's Chosen.

guide.context: This cannot be earned together with the Order of Death's Vigil reputation in one playthrough.

steps.text: In Act Three, side with Kymon's Chosen in the quest @loc{Allies Among the Ashes}.
Do quests and bounties for them until the Faction menu shows Revered.

achievements.description: Reach Revered reputation with the Order of Death's Vigil.
achievements.summary: Reach Revered reputation with the Death's Vigil order.

guide.context: This cannot be earned together with the Kymon's Chosen reputation in one playthrough.

steps.text: In Act Three, choose the Order of Death's Vigil during the quest @loc{Allies Among the Ashes}.
Do quests and bounties for them until the Faction menu shows Revered.

achievements.description: Slay Salazar, Blade of Ch'thon in the Depraved Sanctuary.
achievements.summary: Kill Salazar, the Blade of Ch'thon, inside the Depraved Sanctuary.

steps.text: Get a @item{Strange Key}: let Direni live in the quest @loc{A Cultist in the Midst}, or loot it from cultists nearby or in the Cultist's Lair.
Enter the @loc{Depraved Sanctuary}, east of the Burrwitch Outskirts Riftgate.
Kill @enemy{Salazar, Blade of Ch'thon}.

achievements.description: Slay Salazar, Blade of Ch'thon in the Depraved Sanctuary on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Kill Salazar, the Blade of Ch'thon, inside the Depraved Sanctuary while playing Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Get a @item{Strange Key}: let Direni live in the quest @loc{A Cultist in the Midst}, or loot it from cultists nearby or in the Cultist's Lair.
Enter the @loc{Depraved Sanctuary}, east of the Burrwitch Outskirts Riftgate.
Set the game to Ultimate difficulty and kill @enemy{Salazar, Blade of Ch'thon}. Ultimate is unlocked by finishing the game on Normal, Veteran and Elite first.

achievements.description: Slay Alkamos, Lord Executioner in the Steps of Torment.
achievements.summary: Kill Alkamos, the Lord Executioner, inside the Steps of Torment dungeon.

steps.text: Go to the southern @loc{Broken Hills} and enter the @loc{Steps of Torment}.
Go down to the last level, @loc{Anguish}, and kill @enemy{Alkamos, Lord Executioner}.

achievements.description: Slay Alkamos, Lord Executioner in the Steps of Torment on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Kill Alkamos, the Lord Executioner, inside the Steps of Torment dungeon while playing Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate difficulty. Ultimate is unlocked by finishing the game on Normal, Veteran and Elite first. Go to the southern @loc{Broken Hills} and enter the @loc{Steps of Torment}.
Go down to the last level, @loc{Anguish}, and kill @enemy{Alkamos, Lord Executioner}.

achievements.description: Slay Alkamos, Lord Executioner in the Steps of Torment on Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Kill Alkamos, the Lord Executioner, inside the Steps of Torment dungeon with a Hardcore character.

steps.text: Play a Hardcore character. Go to the southern @loc{Broken Hills} and enter the @loc{Steps of Torment}.
Go down to the last level, @loc{Anguish}, and kill @enemy{Alkamos, Lord Executioner}.

achievements.description: Slay Warden Krieg in the Hidden Laboratory.
achievements.summary: Kill Warden Krieg in the Hidden Laboratory.

steps.text: Do the Act One main quest @loc{The Warden} and kill @enemy{Warden Krieg}.

achievements.description: Slay Darius Cronley.
achievements.summary: Kill Darius Cronley.

steps.text: Do the Act Two quest @loc{An Old Threat} and kill @npc{Darius Cronley}.

achievements.description: Slay Karroz, Sigil of Ch'thon.
achievements.summary: Kill Karroz, Sigil of Ch'thon.

steps.text: Do the Act Three main quest @loc{Reaping What You Sow} and kill @enemy{Karroz, Sigil of Ch'thon}.

achievements.description: Slay the Loghorrean, Voice of Ch'thon.
achievements.summary: Kill the Loghorrean, Voice of Ch'thon.

steps.text: Reach the final main quest @loc{The Bane of Cairn} and kill the @enemy{Loghorrean, Voice of Ch'thon}.

achievements.description: Slay the Herald of Flame in the Conflagration.
achievements.summary: Kill the Herald of Flame inside the Conflagration area.

steps.text: Reach the Act Three area @loc{Conflagration} and kill the @enemy{Herald of Flame}.

achievements.displayName: Not Afraid of a Little Fire
achievements.description: Slay the Herald of Flame in the Conflagration on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Kill the Herald of Flame inside the Conflagration area while playing Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate difficulty. Ultimate is unlocked by finishing the game on Normal, Veteran and Elite first. Reach @loc{Conflagration} in Act Three and kill the @enemy{Herald of Flame}.

achievements.description: Slay Gutworm in Smuggler's Basin.
achievements.summary: Kill Gutworm in Smuggler's Basin.

steps.text: Find @loc{Smuggler's Basin}, an area without a map marker that may appear near the Burrwitch Outskirts, and kill @enemy{Gutworm}.

achievements.description: Slay Gutworm in Smuggler's Basin on Ultimate Difficulty
achievements.summary: Kill Gutworm inside Smuggler's Basin while playing Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate difficulty. Ultimate is unlocked by finishing the game on Normal, Veteran and Elite first. Find @loc{Smuggler's Basin} around the Burrwitch Outskirts and kill @enemy{Gutworm}.

achievements.description: Rescue Darlet in Burrwitch.
achievements.summary: Rescue Darlet in Burrwitch.

steps.text: In Act One, take the side quest @loc{The Inventor's Apprentice} from @npc{Kasparov}.
Rescue @npc{Darlet} in Burrwitch.

achievements.description: Enlist the help of a Blacksmith.
achievements.summary: Get a blacksmith to join you.

steps.text: In Act One, find @npc{Duncan} in the Burrwitch Outskirts and do the side quest @loc{Tale of Two Blacksmiths}.
Pick a blacksmith. Duncan or Angrim then works for you in Devil's Crossing.

achievements.description: Rescue Ulgrim in the Burrwitch Outskirts.
achievements.summary: Rescue Ulgrim in the Burrwitch Outskirts.

steps.text: Find @npc{Ulgrim}, who hides at the centre of the @loc{Burrwitch Outskirts}.
Tell him about the prison.

achievements.description: Craft 10 items.
achievements.summary: Craft 10 items.

steps.text: Unlock the blacksmith, then craft 10 items with blueprints and materials.

achievements.description: Craft 100 items.
achievements.summary: Craft 100 items.

steps.text: Craft 100 items at the blacksmith.

achievements.description: Craft 1000 items.
achievements.summary: Craft 1000 items.

steps.text: Craft 1000 items at the blacksmith.

achievements.description: Craft a Relic.
achievements.summary: Craft a Relic.

steps.text: Get a Relic blueprint and its materials, then craft a @item{Relic} at the blacksmith.

achievements.description: Craft a Transcendent Relic.
achievements.summary: Craft a Transcendent Relic.

steps.text: Get a Transcendent Relic blueprint and its materials, then craft it at the blacksmith.

achievements.description: Craft a Mythical Relic.
achievements.summary: Craft a Mythical Relic.

steps.text: Get a Mythical Relic blueprint from a boss or an Ultimate difficulty shrine.
Collect the rare materials and craft it at the blacksmith.

achievements.description: Open 10 One-Shot Chests.
achievements.summary: Open 10 one-shot chests.

steps.text: Find and open 10 one-shot chests.

achievements.displayName: To the Explorer Go the Spoils
achievements.description: Open 20 One-Shot Chests.
achievements.summary: Open 20 one-shot chests.

steps.text: Find and open 20 one-shot chests.

achievements.description: Restore 10 Devotion Shrines.
achievements.summary: Restore 10 Devotion Shrines.

steps.text: Restore 10 Devotion Shrines.

achievements.description: Restore 50 Devotion Shrines.
achievements.summary: Restore 50 Devotion Shrines.

steps.text: Restore 50 Devotion Shrines.

achievements.description: Reach level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

steps.text: Gain experience until your character is level 10.

achievements.description: Reach level 35.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 35.

steps.text: Gain experience until your character is level 35.

achievements.description: Reach level 50.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 50.

steps.text: Gain experience until your character is level 50.

achievements.description: Reach level 85.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 85.

steps.text: Gain experience until your character is level 85.

achievements.description: Reach level 85 in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 85 in Hardcore Mode.

steps.text: Make a Hardcore character and reach level 85.

achievements.description: Complete the Game on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Ultimate difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the game on Normal, Veteran and Elite difficulty to unlock Ultimate.
Finish the story on Ultimate difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete the Game on Ultimate Difficulty in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Ultimate difficulty in Hardcore Mode.

steps.text: Finish the game on Normal, Veteran and Elite difficulty to unlock Ultimate. Then make a Hardcore character and finish the story on Ultimate difficulty.

achievements.description: Resolve the situation in New Harbor without resorting to violence.
achievements.summary: Settle the New Harbor situation without violence.

steps.text: In Act Two, take the side quest @loc{Paying Tributes} from @npc{Alicia} in New Harbor.
Either deliver the scrap to @npc{Silas}, or pay him a 2500 Iron bribe.

achievements.description: Slay Anasteria.
achievements.summary: Kill Anasteria.

steps.text: In Act Four, take the quest @loc{The Aetherial Witch} from @npc{Captain Reave}.
Kill the possessed witch @enemy{Anasteria}. You must kill her for the achievement, even if you may ally with her.

achievements.displayName: I Was Not Expecting You, Human
achievements.description: Slay Warden Krieg on Veteran Mode before reaching level 11.
achievements.summary: Kill Warden Krieg on Veteran difficulty before reaching level 11.

guide.context: If the kill gives you level 11, the achievement does not unlock. Stay low enough in level before the fight.

steps.text: Finish the game on Normal difficulty to unlock Veteran, then start a second character on Veteran difficulty.
Reach @loc{The Warden} quest and kill @enemy{Warden Krieg} while still under level 11.

achievements.description: Secure the Burrwitch Riftgate in Veteran Mode.
achievements.summary: Close the Burrwitch Riftgate on Veteran difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the game on Normal difficulty to unlock Veteran, then play on Veteran difficulty.
Secure the Riftgate in Burrwitch Village.

achievements.description: Discover what is concealed behind the collapsed rocks in the Flooded Passage.
achievements.summary: Reveal the secret area that the Flooded Passage rockfall blocks.

steps.text: Set 3 dynamite on the blast spot in the @loc{Flooded Passage}.
Enter the @loc{Sunken Reliquary} behind the cleared rocks.

achievements.description: Uncover Darius Cronley's Secret.
achievements.summary: Find Darius Cronley's secret laboratory.

steps.text: Kill @npc{Darius Cronley} in his hideout.
Search the hideout for the secret room and use the @item{Aether Cluster} in the laboratory.

achievements.description: Find the buried treasure in the farmlands near Homestead.
achievements.summary: Dig up the hidden chest in the fields close to Homestead.

steps.text: Loot @item{The Last Will of Marthos Everbrook} from a body inside a house in the Infested Farms or Rotting Croplands.
Bring 1 dynamite and open the buried chest the document points to.

achievements.displayName: In the Depths, He Lived Forgotten
achievements.description: Slay Gollus, the Deepdweller.
achievements.summary: Kill Gollus, the Deepdweller.

steps.text: In Act Three, enter the @loc{Skittering Den} and find the secret @loc{Den of the Lost}.
Kill @enemy{Gollus, the Deepdweller}.

achievements.description: Survive the Chamber of Souls.
achievements.summary: Survive the Chamber of Souls.

steps.text: Enter the Chamber of Souls on the fourth level, @loc{Suffering}, of the Steps of Torment.
Beat all three waves of monsters before the room reopens.

achievements.description: Collect 5 Lore Notes
achievements.summary: Collect 5 lore notes.

steps.text: Find and read lore notes around the world until you have collected 5.

achievements.description: Collect 20 Lore Notes
achievements.summary: Collect 20 lore notes.

steps.text: Find and read lore notes around the world until you have collected 20.

achievements.description: Collect 50 Lore Notes
achievements.summary: Collect 50 lore notes.

steps.text: Find and read lore notes around the world until you have collected 50.

achievements.description: Survive the Fields of Despair.
achievements.summary: Survive the Fields of Despair.

steps.text: Enter the Bastion of Chaos through the @loc{Chthonic Rift} in the north of the Necropolis Interior.
Reach the second level, Discord, and survive the Fields of Despair, where several rooms release waves of enemies.

achievements.description: Defeat the Avatar of Mogdrogen.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Avatar of Mogdrogen.

steps.text: Reach Honored with the Rovers and complete the Act Two side quest @loc{Rhowari Legacy} from @npc{Amkala}.
Go to @loc{Asterkarn Valley} and defeat the @enemy{Avatar of Mogdrogen}.

achievements.description: Slay Shar'Zul, Harbinger of Chaos in the Bastion of Chaos.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Shar'Zul at the end of the Bastion of Chaos.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Necropolis Interior} and cross @loc{Necropolis Bridge}.
Enter the @loc{Chthonic Rift} in the north of the area to reach the @loc{Bastion of Chaos}.
Clear the Bastion and defeat @enemy{Shar'Zul}, its final boss.

achievements.description: Slay Shar'Zul, Harbinger of Chaos in the Bastion of Chaos on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Shar'Zul on Ultimate difficulty at the end of the Bastion of Chaos.

steps.text: Unlock Ultimate difficulty by finishing Normal, Veteran and Elite first.
Enter the @loc{Bastion of Chaos} through the @loc{Chthonic Rift} in northern @loc{Necropolis Interior}.
Defeat @enemy{Shar'Zul} on Ultimate difficulty.

achievements.description: Slay Shar'Zul, Harbinger of Chaos in the Bastion of Chaos in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Shar'Zul at the end of the Bastion of Chaos with a Hardcore Mode character.

guide.context: A death in Hardcore Mode ends the character.

steps.text: Create a Hardcore Mode character and play to @loc{Necropolis Interior}.
Enter the @loc{Bastion of Chaos} through the @loc{Chthonic Rift} in the north.
Defeat @enemy{Shar'Zul}.

achievements.description: Slay Archon Barthollem in the name of the Order of Death's Vigil on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat Archon Barthollem on Ultimate difficulty after siding with the Order of Death's Vigil.

guide.context: Siding with the Order locks out the Kymon's Chosen path on that playthrough.

steps.text: Unlock Ultimate difficulty by finishing Normal, Veteran and Elite first.
In the Act Three quest @mechanic{Allies Among the Ashes}, side with the @npc{Order of Death's Vigil}.
Defeat @enemy{Archon Barthollem}.
steps.note: Take the Kymon's Chosen path on another playthrough for the matching achievement.

achievements.description: Slay Malkadarr in the name of Kymon's Chosen on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat Malkadarr on Ultimate difficulty after siding with Kymon's Chosen.

guide.context: Siding with Kymon's Chosen locks out the Order of Death's Vigil path on that playthrough.

steps.text: Unlock Ultimate difficulty by finishing Normal, Veteran and Elite first.
In the Act Three quest @mechanic{Allies Among the Ashes}, side with @npc{Kymon's Chosen}.
Defeat their leader, @enemy{Malkadarr}.
steps.note: Take the Order of Death's Vigil path on another playthrough for the matching achievement.

achievements.description: Slay the Herald of Destruction in the Immolation.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Herald of Destruction who waits inside the Immolation.

steps.text: Reach Honored reputation with the @npc{Black Legion}.
In Act Four, take the quest @mechanic{Legion Retribution} from @npc{Spellbreaker Moira}.
Kill the @enemy{Herald of Destruction} inside the @loc{Immolation}.

achievements.description: Slay the Herald of Destruction in the Immolation on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Herald of Destruction on Ultimate difficulty inside the Immolation.

steps.text: Unlock Ultimate difficulty by finishing Normal, Veteran and Elite first.
Reach Honored with the @npc{Black Legion} and take @mechanic{Legion Retribution} from @npc{Spellbreaker Moira}.
Kill the @enemy{Herald of Destruction} inside the @loc{Immolation}.

achievements.description: Complete the Game.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story of the base game.

steps.text: Play through the main quests of the story to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Game on Elite Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story of the base game on Elite difficulty.

steps.text: Finish Normal and Veteran difficulty to unlock Elite.
Start a character on Elite and play the main story to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Crucible.
achievements.summary: Clear wave 150 of the Crucible on Aspirant difficulty.

guide.context: You can retake the Crucible from the wave 50, 100 and 150 checkpoints. Dying in softcore costs you the loot.

steps.text: Start the game in Crucible Mode and pick Aspirant difficulty.
Survive and clear every wave up to wave 150.

achievements.description: Complete the Crucible through Wave 150 on Challenger Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Clear wave 150 of the Crucible on Challenger difficulty.

steps.text: Clear wave 100 on Aspirant to unlock Challenger difficulty.
Start the Crucible on Challenger and clear wave 150.

achievements.description: Complete the Crucible through Wave 150 on Gladiator Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Clear wave 150 of the Crucible on Gladiator difficulty.

steps.text: Clear wave 100 on Challenger to unlock Gladiator difficulty.
Start the Crucible on Gladiator and clear wave 150.

achievements.description: Earn a Crucible score of at least 900000.
achievements.summary: Earn 900000 or more score in the Crucible.

steps.text: Play the Crucible on Aspirant and keep killing to hold the score multiplier.

achievements.description: Earn a Crucible score of at least 5000000.
achievements.summary: Earn 5000000 or more score in the Crucible.

steps.text: Play the Crucible on Challenger and keep killing to hold the score multiplier.
Check the score in the top right corner as you near wave 150.

achievements.description: Earn a Crucible score of at least 10000000.
achievements.summary: Earn 10000000 or more score in the Crucible.

steps.text: Play the Crucible on Gladiator, or push Challenger past wave 150.
Keep killing to hold the x10 score multiplier.

achievements.description: Complete the Crucible through Wave 150 on Gladiator Difficulty with the 6th Spawn Point active.
achievements.summary: Clear wave 150 of the Crucible on Gladiator while the 6th spawn point is active.

guide.context: The extra spawn dialog appears after you finish wave 150 on Gladiator.

steps.text: Complete the Crucible on Gladiator first.
Talk to @npc{Lokarr} and ask to retake the Crucible.
Pick @mechanic{I wish to raise the stakes}, then the reply that starts with @mechanic{Sure}.
Choose a checkpoint so the 6th spawn point is active, then clear wave 150.

achievements.description: Construct a Defensive Structure.
achievements.summary: Build one defensive structure in the Crucible.

guide.context: A built defense cannot be removed or changed.

steps.text: In the Crucible, click a blue area on the map.
Pick a defense and confirm to build it.

achievements.description: Construct 50 Defenses.
achievements.summary: Build 50 defensive structures in the Crucible.

guide.context: Upgrades do not count, only newly built defenses.

steps.text: Start a Crucible run and spend your tributes and iron on defenses at the blue areas.
Restart the run and build again until you have built 50 in total.

achievements.description: Activate a Celestial Blessing.
achievements.summary: Activate one Celestial Blessing in the Crucible.

steps.text: In the Crucible, talk to @npc{Torralia}.
Pay 12 tributes to activate a blessing.

achievements.description: Activate 25 Celestial Blessings.
achievements.summary: Activate Celestial Blessings 25 times in the Crucible.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Torralia} and pay 12 tributes for a blessing.
Re-activate blessings whenever they expire, until you have used 25.

achievements.description: Activate all 4 Celestial Blessings in a single Crucible.
achievements.summary: Activate all four Celestial Blessings in a single Crucible run.

guide.context: Blessings do not last forever, so activate the last ones soon after the first.

steps.text: Save up 48 tributes during one run.
Talk to @npc{Torralia} and activate all four blessings.

achievements.description: Survive the Flames of Valbury.
achievements.summary: Survive the Flames of Valbury.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Port Valbury} through the Aetherial rift in the @loc{Conflagration}.
Keep progressing through the sealed dungeon and survive.

achievements.description: Slay Overlord Van Aldritch in Port Valbury.
achievements.summary: Defeat Overlord Van Aldritch in Port Valbury.

steps.text: Blow up the Aether crystals with dynamite in the @loc{Conflagration} to open the rift to @loc{Port Valbury}.
Use a crafted @item{Skeleton Key} to go past the first area.
Fight through to @loc{High Town} and defeat @enemy{Overlord Van Aldritch}.

achievements.description: Slay Overlord Van Aldritch in Port Valbury on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat Overlord Van Aldritch on Ultimate difficulty in Port Valbury.

steps.text: Unlock Ultimate difficulty by finishing Normal, Veteran and Elite first.
Craft a @item{Skeleton Key}; it is needed to go past the first area of @loc{Port Valbury}.
Defeat @enemy{Overlord Van Aldritch} on Ultimate difficulty.

achievements.description: Slay Overlord Van Aldritch in Port Valbury in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat Overlord Van Aldritch in Port Valbury with a Hardcore Mode character.

guide.context: You cannot leave Port Valbury by riftgate, and a death ends a Hardcore character.

steps.text: Use a Hardcore Mode character and prepare a crafted @item{Skeleton Key}.
Enter @loc{Port Valbury} and fight through to @enemy{Overlord Van Aldritch}.

achievements.description: Clear the Aetherial Barrier north of Burrwitch.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Aetherial Barrier that lies north of Burrwitch.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Burrwitch Estates} in the top right corner of the map.
Go north of Burrwitch and clear the @loc{Aetherial Barrier} there.

achievements.description: Choose to remain friendly with the people of Barrowholm.
achievements.summary: Choose to stay friendly with the people of Barrowholm.

guide.context: Friendly and hostile are alternative choices. Pick the other one on another playthrough.

steps.text: Stay friendly with the people of Barrowholm in Ashes of Malmouth.

achievements.description: Choose to be hostile with the people of Barrowholm.
achievements.summary: Choose to turn hostile toward the people of Barrowholm.

guide.context: Friendly and hostile are alternative choices. Pick the other one on another playthrough.

steps.text: Turn hostile toward the people of Barrowholm in Ashes of Malmouth.

achievements.description: Convince Ulgrim at the Void's Edge that you are on his side.
achievements.summary: Talk Ulgrim into believing you are on his side at the Void's Edge.

guide.context: Talking and fighting are alternatives, so you need another playthrough for the other one.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Ulgrim} at the @loc{Void's Edge}.
Talk to him and pick the friendliest dialog options.

achievements.description: Fight Ulgrim at the Void's Edge instead of talking, and bring him to half health.
achievements.summary: Fight Ulgrim at the Void's Edge and bring him down to half health.

guide.context: The fight is hard, so it is easier on Normal difficulty. Talking and fighting are alternatives, so you need another playthrough for the other one.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Ulgrim} at the @loc{Void's Edge}.
Skip the friendly dialog options and attack him.
Reduce his health to 50 percent.

achievements.description: Retake the Malmouth Resistance Base in the Steelcap District.
achievements.summary: Retake the Resistance Base of Malmouth in the Steelcap District.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Steelcap District}.
Survive the waves of enemies at the Riftgate.

achievements.description: Reach level 100.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 100.

achievements.summary: Survive the Hungering Darkness event in the Tomb of the Heretic.

steps.text: Collect the three seals, then open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} entrance in the Valley of the Chosen and bring a skeleton key.
Fight each round of enemies in the event chamber.
Run to another side of the room to avoid the floor tentacles.

guide.note: Do not skip the event chamber on the way to the boss.

achievements.description: Slay Grand Magus Morgoneth in the Tomb of the Heretic.
achievements.summary: Defeat Grand Magus Morgoneth inside the Tomb of the Heretic.

steps.text: Collect the three seals, then open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} entrance in the Valley of the Chosen and bring a skeleton key.
Fight through the dungeon to @enemy{Grand Magus Morgoneth} and slay him.
Keep moving: he uses many area attacks and projectiles.

achievements.description: Slay Grand Magus Morgoneth in the Tomb of the Heretic on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat Grand Magus Morgoneth inside the Tomb of the Heretic while playing on Ultimate Difficulty.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty. Collect the three seals, then open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} entrance in the Valley of the Chosen and bring a skeleton key.
Fight through the dungeon to @enemy{Grand Magus Morgoneth} and slay him.
Keep moving: he uses many area attacks and projectiles.

achievements.description: Slay Grand Magus Morgoneth in the Tomb of the Heretic on Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat Grand Magus Morgoneth inside the Tomb of the Heretic with a Hardcore character.

steps.text: Use a Hardcore character. Collect the three seals, then open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} entrance in the Valley of the Chosen and bring a skeleton key.
Fight through the dungeon to @enemy{Grand Magus Morgoneth} and slay him.
Keep moving: he uses many area attacks and projectiles.

achievements.description: Slay 5 Associates of Riggs in a single journey.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 Associates of Riggs without leaving the game or returning to the main menu.

steps.text: Stay in the game without closing it or returning to the main menu.
Slay 5 Associates of Riggs in this single journey.

guide.note: You can turn Associates on or off even after the Riggs quest is finished.

achievements.description: Settle your debt with Riggs.
achievements.summary: Give Riggs the Iris of Eternal Night to settle your debt with him.

steps.text: Get the three seals: Maw of Enaht from @enemy{Gurblix the Digested}, Forlorn Bastion from @enemy{Jarinthor the Sandstorm}, and Howling Depths from @enemy{Hallanx the Forgotten}.
Open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} entrance in the Valley of the Chosen.
Clear the dungeon and loot the @item{Iris of Eternal Night} in the final room.
Give the Iris to Riggs.

achievements.description: Slay all seven of the Korvan Magi in the Tomb of the Heretic.
achievements.summary: Defeat each of the seven Korvan Magi inside the Tomb of the Heretic.

guide.context: The two Magi in each run are random and can repeat, so expect several runs.

steps.text: Collect the three seals, then open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} entrance in the Valley of the Chosen and bring a skeleton key. Each run spawns 2 Korvan Magi.
Slay all seven: Sethris, Orissia, Anubar, Tawrot, Basti, Shuroth and Khonsar.

achievements.description: Meet the Kurn of Asterkarn.
achievements.summary: Meet the Kurn of Asterkarn.

steps.text: Follow the main story of Fangs of Asterkarn.

achievements.displayName: I'm on Top of the World
achievements.description: Reach the Roof of the World.
achievements.summary: Reach the Roof of the World.

steps.text: Follow the main story of Fangs of Asterkarn until you reach the @loc{Roof of the World}.

achievements.description: Melt one of the glacial barriers in Asterkarn.
achievements.summary: Melt a glacial barrier somewhere in Asterkarn.

steps.text: Gather 10 Tainted Meat from animals in the Dread Wastes.
Buy an Inert Orb from the merchant Dulgirr at the Black Citadel.
Combine them at the Purifying Altar near the Black Citadel Rift to make a Magma Sphere.
Walk to a glacier, such as the first one east of the Guardian's Sorrow Rift, to melt it.

achievements.description: Meet the Hranaak Elder.
achievements.summary: Meet the Hranaak Elder.

steps.text: Go a bit west of the Guardian's Sorrow Rift.
Go through the woods and boulders and cross the river to reach the entrance.

achievements.description: Restore Kurn relations with the Dranghouls of Asterkarn.
achievements.summary: Finish the Old Allies quest and make peace between the Kurn and the Dranghouls of Asterkarn.

steps.text: Complete Old Wounds. Then raise your standing with the Kurn to Respected.
Take the Old Allies quest from @npc{Thane Vilgar} at Kurnhold.
Melt the glacier (see Glacial Warming) to reach the Dranghoul settlement in Kruu'Sul Crags.
Finish the small arena event there.

achievements.description: Retake the Bloodbound Bastion for the Kurn.
achievements.summary: Take back the Bloodbound Bastion on behalf of the Kurn.

steps.text: Finish Trial by Blood.
Meet @npc{Chief Snarltooth} in front of the western gate of the Bloodbound Bastion.
Win the long fight inside the Bastion.

achievements.description: Lay fallen Kurn heroes to rest.
achievements.summary: Lay fallen Kurn heroes to rest by freeing three souls in the crypt near the Utak Kunar rift.

steps.text: Take the quest from @npc{Veilwalker Utaro}, in a shack south and then east of the Utak Kunar rift.
Enter the crypt just east of the Utak Kunar rift.
Free all three souls, each in its own way: slay one, bind one, and bring the requested sword to the one that asks for it.
The sword comes from @npc{Krakune}, who stands right north of the Bloodbound Bastion. Buy it from him or fight him for it.

achievements.description: Assume the form of the beast as a Berserker.
achievements.summary: Assume the form of the beast by using the Berserker's Werewolf skill.

steps.text: Pick the Berserker mastery.
Put one point in Werewolf.
Activate the skill.

achievements.description: Deal with Chieftain Scorv by slaying him.
achievements.summary: Slay Chieftain Scorv while hostile to Barrowholm.

steps.text: Become hostile to Barrowholm. If you are on Ultimate and friendly with Barrowholm, drop to Elite difficulty and change your loyalty there.
Go north from the Ulo's Springs rift and melt the glacier there.
Go far east to find @enemy{Chieftain Scorv} and slay him.

achievements.description: Slay Evernight, the Hypporaven menace.
achievements.summary: Defeat Evernight, the Hypporaven menace.

steps.text: Get the quest from @npc{Grisha}, north of the Guardian's Sorrow Rift.
Go to the northeast of Ulo's Springs and slay @enemy{Evernight}.

achievements.description: Slay Evernight, the Hypporaven menace on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, defeat Evernight, the Hypporaven menace.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Get the quest from @npc{Grisha}, north of the Guardian's Sorrow Rift.
Go to the northeast of Ulo's Springs and slay @enemy{Evernight}.

achievements.description: Slay the giants Ulderthorm Tempestborn and Igron Worldbreaker in the lands of Asterkarn.
achievements.summary: Defeat the two giants of Asterkarn: Ulderthorm Tempestborn and Igron Worldbreaker.

steps.text: Slay @enemy{Ulderthorm Tempestborn} in the middle of the Glacial Grotto, far north of the Black Citadel.
Slay @enemy{Igron Worldbreaker} in the Freyon Valley.

achievements.description: Slay the giants Ulderthorm Tempestborn and Igron Worldbreaker in the lands of Asterkarn on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, defeat the two giants of Asterkarn: Ulderthorm Tempestborn and Igron Worldbreaker.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Slay @enemy{Ulderthorm Tempestborn} in the middle of the Glacial Grotto, far north of the Black Citadel.
Slay @enemy{Igron Worldbreaker} in the Freyon Valley.

achievements.description: Slay Siff Icehowl in the Frostveil Highlands.
achievements.summary: Defeat Siff Icehowl in the Frostveil Highlands.

steps.text: Travel to Icehowl Cavern in the Frostveil Highlands, in the far north near the Kurn Bonfire rift.
Slay @enemy{Siff Icehowl}.

achievements.description: Slay Siff Icehowl in the Frostveil Highlands on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, defeat Siff Icehowl in the Frostveil Highlands.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Travel to Icehowl Cavern in the Frostveil Highlands, in the far north near the Kurn Bonfire rift.
Slay @enemy{Siff Icehowl}.

achievements.description: Banish Nyarlathon, Herald of Annihilation.
achievements.summary: Banish Nyarlathon, Herald of Annihilation.

steps.text: Farm Bloodsworn infamy, for example at or just south of the Black Citadel, and turn on the +25% reputation bonus at the Altar of Ascension.
Defeat @enemy{Nyarlathon}, the nemesis of the Bloodsworn, to banish it.

achievements.description: Banish Nyarlathon, Herald of Annihilation on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, banish Nyarlathon, Herald of Annihilation.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Farm Bloodsworn infamy, for example at or just south of the Black Citadel, and turn on the +25% reputation bonus at the Altar of Ascension.
Defeat @enemy{Nyarlathon}, the nemesis of the Bloodsworn, to banish it.

achievements.description: Slay Naddo the Anointed in the Heart of the Void.
achievements.summary: Defeat Naddo the Anointed, deep inside the Heart of the Void.

steps.text: Collect a Blood of Ch'thon for each Blood Basin from the cultists; they drop quite a few.
Use the three Blood Basins around the World Tear, one on each of its east, west and north sides, at the center of the Black Citadel.
Enter the World Tear and slay @enemy{Naddo the Anointed} on its last level.

achievements.description: Slay Naddo the Anointed in the Heart of the Void on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, defeat Naddo the Anointed, deep inside the Heart of the Void.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Use a Blood of Ch'thon on each of the three Blood Basins to open the World Tear.
Slay @enemy{Naddo the Anointed} on its last level.

achievements.description: Slay Prodromus, Herald of the End Times in the Aurora Peaks.
achievements.summary: In the Aurora Peaks, defeat Prodromus, Herald of the End Times.

steps.text: Follow the main quest to the boss just before the final boss.
Slay @enemy{Prodromus}.

achievements.description: Slay Prodromus, Herald of the End Times in the Aurora Peaks on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, in the Aurora Peaks, defeat Prodromus, Herald of the End Times.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Follow the main quest to the boss just before the final boss.
Slay @enemy{Prodromus}.

achievements.description: Cleanse Beronath, Corruptor of Asterkarn on the Roof of the World.
achievements.summary: Cleanse Beronath, Corruptor of Asterkarn, atop the Roof of the World.

steps.text: Follow the main quest to the @loc{Roof of the World}.
Cleanse @enemy{Beronath} (the final boss).
Avoid the red-earthquake shotgun attack and the puddles.

achievements.description: Cleanse Beronath, Corruptor of Asterkarn on the Roof of the World on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, cleanse Beronath, Corruptor of Asterkarn, atop the Roof of the World.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty.
Cleanse @enemy{Beronath} on the @loc{Roof of the World}.

guide.note: If it does not unlock on a Hardcore character, finish on a Softcore character.

achievements.description: Cleanse Beronath, Corruptor of Asterkarn on the Roof of the World in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, cleanse Beronath, Corruptor of Asterkarn, atop the Roof of the World.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Cleanse @enemy{Beronath} on the @loc{Roof of the World}.

guide.note: If it does not unlock on a Hardcore character, finish on a Softcore character.

achievements.description: Survive the Dread.
achievements.summary: Survive the Dread by bringing it down to about 20% health, when it flees.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode, where the Dread is expected to appear. The Altar of Ascension can raise its chance, or let it appear on lower difficulties.
Fight the Dread and stay away from the blood pools; they heal it.
Bring it down to about 20% health. It runs away and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Reach Revered reputation with the Kurn.
achievements.summary: Reach Revered reputation with the Kurn.

steps.text: Complete all Kurn quests.
Slay Bloodsworn and Ch'thonians.

achievements.description: Reach Revered reputation with the Hranaak.
achievements.summary: Reach Revered reputation with the Hranaak.

steps.text: Complete every Hranaak quest; quests are the only way to gain reputation.
Open the troves after a rogue dungeon event is finished so its quest counts as complete.

guide.note: To skip a quest, do not accept it. Quit to the main menu and load the game again.

achievements.description: Complete Fangs of Asterkarn.
achievements.summary: Complete Fangs of Asterkarn.

steps.text: Finish the story by cleansing @enemy{Beronath}.

achievements.description: Complete Fangs of Asterkarn on Elite Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Elite Difficulty, finish the Fangs of Asterkarn campaign.

steps.text: Play on Elite Difficulty and finish the story by cleansing @enemy{Beronath}.

achievements.description: Complete Fangs of Asterkarn on Ultimate Difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Ultimate Difficulty, finish the Fangs of Asterkarn campaign.

steps.text: Play on Ultimate Difficulty and finish the story by cleansing @enemy{Beronath}.

achievements.description: Complete Fangs of Asterkarn on Ultimate Difficulty in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: With a Hardcore character on Ultimate Difficulty, finish the Fangs of Asterkarn campaign.

steps.text: Use a Hardcore character on Ultimate Difficulty and finish the story by cleansing @enemy{Beronath}.

achievements.description: Restore 65 Devotion Shrines.
achievements.summary: Restore 65 Devotion Shrines.

steps.text: Restore Devotion Shrines as you explore Asterkarn until you reach 65.

achievements.description: Open 40 One-Shot Chests.
achievements.summary: Open 40 One-Shot Chests.

steps.text: Open One-Shot Chests as you explore Asterkarn until you reach 40.

achievements.description: Collect 100 Lore Notes.
achievements.summary: Collect 100 Lore Notes.

steps.text: Pick up Lore Notes as you explore Asterkarn until you reach 100.

achievements.description: Activate the Altar of Ascension.
achievements.summary: Activate the Altar of Ascension.

steps.text: Reach Kurnhold and progress the main story until the Kurn trust you.
Use the @mechanic{Altar of Ascension}.

achievements.description: Activate the Altar of Ascension with all materials filled.
achievements.summary: Activate the Altar of Ascension with every material slot filled.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Altar of Ascension}.
Fill every place in the center and the outer circles with crafting materials, then activate it.

achievements.description: Slay a boss in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: Slay a boss in Ascendant Mode.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode and slay any boss.

achievements.description: Slay 10 bosses in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: Slay 10 bosses in Ascendant Mode.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode and slay 10 bosses.

achievements.description: Slay Warden Krieg in the Hidden Laboratory in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Warden Krieg inside the Hidden Laboratory.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the @loc{Hidden Laboratory} (nearest rift: Warden's Laboratory Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Warden Krieg}.

achievements.description: Slay the Loghorrean, Voice of Ch'thon in the Edge of Madness in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat the Loghorrean, Voice of Ch'thon inside the Edge of Madness.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the @loc{Edge of Madness} (nearest rift: Necropolis Interior Rift).
Defeat @enemy{the Loghorrean, Voice of Ch'thon}.

achievements.description: Slay Theodin Marcell, the Shaper of Flesh in the Sanctum of Flesh in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Theodin Marcell, the Shaper of Flesh inside the Sanctum of Flesh.

guide.context: Marcell is in Ashes of Malmouth, so you must own that expansion too.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the @loc{Sanctum of Flesh} (nearest rift: Malmouth Crown Hill Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Theodin Marcell, the Shaper of Flesh}.

achievements.description: Slay Korvaak, the Eldritch Sun in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Korvaak, the Eldritch Sun.

guide.context: Korvaak is in Forgotten Gods, so you must own that expansion too.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the nearest rift (Eldritch Gate Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Korvaak, the Eldritch Sun}.

achievements.description: Slay Alkamos, Lord Executioner in the Steps of Torment in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Alkamos, Lord Executioner inside the Steps of Torment.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the @loc{Steps of Torment} (nearest rift: Broken Hills Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Alkamos, Lord Executioner}.

achievements.description: Slay Shar'Zul, Harbinger of Chaos in the Bastion of Chaos in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Shar'Zul, Harbinger of Chaos inside the Bastion of Chaos.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the @loc{Bastion of Chaos} (nearest rift: Necropolis Interior Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Shar'Zul, Harbinger of Chaos}.

achievements.description: Slay Overlord Van Aldritch in Port Valbury in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Overlord Van Aldritch inside Port Valbury.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to @loc{Port Valbury} (nearest rift: Homestead Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Overlord Van Aldritch}.

achievements.description: Slay Gargabol, Heart of the Wild in the Ancient Grove in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Gargabol, Heart of the Wild inside the Ancient Grove.

guide.context: Gargabol is in Ashes of Malmouth, so you must own that expansion too.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Head to the @loc{Ancient Grove} (nearest rift: Coven's Refuge Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Gargabol, Heart of the Wild}.

achievements.description: Slay Grand Magus Morgoneth in the Tomb of the Heretic in Ascendant Mode.
achievements.summary: In Ascendant Mode, defeat Grand Magus Morgoneth inside the Tomb of the Heretic.

guide.context: The Tomb of the Heretic is in Forgotten Gods, so you must own that expansion too.

steps.text: Play in Ascendant Mode.
Collect the three seals, then open the @loc{Tomb of the Heretic} with a skeleton key (nearest rift: Lost Oasis Rift).
Defeat @enemy{Grand Magus Morgoneth}.

achievements.description: Reveal one of the hidden caches concealed around Cairn.
achievements.summary: Reveal one of the hidden caches around Cairn.

steps.text: Get Revered with Noktukari, then purchase the Occullorum potion effect from their vendor.
Set the effect at the Kurnhold cauldron.
Find a strange mushroom circle in Cairn and drink the potion inside it.

achievements.displayName: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe
achievements.description: Reveal 10 of the hidden caches concealed around Cairn.
achievements.summary: Reveal 10 hidden caches around Cairn.

steps.text: Get Revered with Noktukari, then purchase the Occullorum potion effect from their vendor.
Set the effect at the Kurnhold cauldron.
Drink the potion inside strange mushroom circles around Cairn until 10 caches are revealed.
